name: Gradient Shading
definition: Performs volume rendering using ray casting. Supports gradient shading for lighting effects. Uses transfer functions to map voxel values to color/opacity. Supports MIP (Maximum Intensity Projection) mode.
summary: Gradient Shading enhances surface perception in volume rendering by computing per-voxel lighting from local intensity gradients, distinguishing itself by relying on explicit gradient vectors rather than learned classification boundaries.
